notes.title: Live in Stalagshire update now available!
notes.notes:
The Mystery of Caketropolis: Live in Stalagshire update is now live! 20+ mins of bonus story content available after you achieve the true ending of the game.

The update adds three bonus episodes, each exploring a different set of events after the conclusion of the story (and why it is locked behind the completion of the true ending). You can access the new content by selecting the 'Bonus' option on the Title Screen.

The 'Bonus' menu will only appear after you've gotten the true ending.

It is recommended to play the episodes listed in the following order:

[olist]
[*] From Within
[*] Live in Stalagshire!
[*] Non-Existent Future
[/olist]

Four new original tracks will released alongside this update, which will be available on Youtube, Spotify and other music streaming platforms. Those who purchased the  Steam soundtrack bundle will also have these tracks updated in their library.

Releasing this update concludes the development of The Mystery of Caketropolis. I've done what I've sought out to achieve, and now it's time for me to move on to other projects. I still want to get involved in game development in the future. Either working on a sequel, or a project with completely different characters and themes. And I hope for TMoC to be just the first step in the right direction. 

You can follow [url=https://twitter.com/derpmentus]@derpmentus[/url] on Twitter for arts and update related/unrelated to TMoC.

If you're interested in my merch, I have a store at https://rimentus.com/shop/

notes.title: TMoC: Live in Stalagshire update coming on March 18!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.

Happy to announce that the update is nearly ready and will be released on March 18.

The upcoming bonus content will also include 4 new tracks that will be added to the OST.

A mix of intrigue, silliness and more mystery lies ahead.  See you next week!

notes.title: The Mystery of Caketropolis: Live in Stalagshire! - Future Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.

Thank you for playing The Mystery of Caketropolis. Happy to announce that I've started work on additional content for the game, namely aimed at those who have finished the true ending of the game and wanted some clarification on certain plot points that were left unresolved. They're basically bonus cutscenes with a bit of interaction here and there, some serious and some for fun (around 15-20mins of extra playtime).

The bonus content will be divided in three mini-chapters, with each taking the point of view of a different character. The names of the episodes are as follows:

[list]
[*] From Within
[*] Live in Stalagshire!
[*] The Non-Existent Future
[/list]

Each mini-chapter will be accompanied by new music, which will made available to listen for those who purchased the soundtrack. And will be uploaded onto Youtube & Spotify.

I dont have a deadline set in stone at the moment, but I'm aiming to get the update done within the next three months.

For more updates and arts, you can find me on my [url=https://twitter.com/derpmentus]Twitter[/url].
